messages:
maria (product): quick one — infra flagged a regression in embeddings cache and tenant SSO integration. current milestone at risk. thinking: ship MVP without tenant SSO, include a trimmed embcache (LRU + prefix cache), push v1 (with full SSO + perf fixes) by 2 weeks. need decision and blockers by EOD. TL;DR: MVP = minimal UX, no tenant SSO; v1 = full SSO + perf.
kevin (eng): can MVP still meet latency SLO? we have 99p latency target 200ms for gen calls. embcache helps but reduced features may still spike.
nash (eng-runtime): traced embcache regression to kv-eviction bug in 2.1 kernel path. quick patch exists but it's risky under heavy tail. propose fallback: route critical tenants to stable quantized model variant until patch proven. :thinking_face:
jamie (pm): ACME pilot requires SSO but they've said pilot-only toggle is acceptable. if we can scope a guarded rollout for 1-2 tenants, that unblocks their pilot.
lena (sales): ACME will sign pilot if we enable SSO for them. confirm: we don't promise GA SSO, just pilot toggle + manual ops. they want timeboxed delivery.
maria (product): ok — refined proposal: ship MVP public without tenant SSO; provide a "pilot SSO" toggle for ACME + one strategic customer only, gated by manual rollout and extra tests. v1 = GA SSO + embcache perf fixes + regression test suite, scheduled +14 days from current milestone.
kevin (eng): we need clear acceptance criteria for pilot SSO and a gating checklist. also assign owner for manual rollback/ops.
nash (eng-runtime): on it. i'll prepare a small runbook and add synthetic tail tests that simulate the heavy request distribution. will also instrument KV eviction metrics.
jamie (pm): i'll coordinate with ACME for pilot window and run the acceptance checklist with them. want to keep scope minimal: org-level SSO + basic SCIM provisioning later.
lena (sales): i'll draft the pilot comms and update contract notes. we should avoid language that implies GA.
maria (product): owners: kevin -> rollout gating + acceptance criteria, nash -> embcache patch + monitoring, jamie -> customer ops, lena -> comms. i'll update roadmap/PRD and notify stakeholders.
deploy-bot: build 7182 started for branch/release/milestone. status: running
kevin (eng): i'll PR the test matrix and gating checklist by noon. if we observe >1% tail latency regression on perf harness we hold the pilot.
maria (product): decision captured. action items: update roadmap, create pilot toggle runbook, schedule 14-day v1 buffer, notify customers and legal about pilot terms. :white_check_mark:
